pr_title: Bluetooth: Host: Add ISO tx check for LOG_WRN in le_init_iso
pr_body:
The warning should only apply for configurations where the device may actually send ISO data (e.g. not the ISO sync receiver).

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/68931

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: ISO: Incorrect warning for ISO Sync Receiver
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
If only the ISO sync receiver is enabled and the `BT_HCI_OP_LE_READ_BUFFER_SIZE_V2` command is not available, then that is not really an issue, as the buffers from `BT_HCI_OP_LE_READ_BUFFER_SIZE_V2` is only from host to controller, and the ISO Sync Receiver will never send ISO data. 

The warning in `le_init_iso` 
```
bt_hci_core: Read Buffer Size V2 command is not supported.No ISO buffers will be available
```

Should not be logged in this case. 

**To Reproduce**
Build and run https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/tree/main/samples/bluetooth/broadcast_audio_sink on an nRF52* board (including the BSIM board). and see the warning log.

**Expected behavior**
Expect no log. 

**Impact**
Minor

**Logs and console output**
See above

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: e72ac4b0917e259ae7ddda2dee5e25c5ea6c0978

**Additional context**
N/A
